description: Finds lookalike domains of a brand (typos, homoglyphs including IDN, TLD swaps, added words like -claim or -airdrop), checks which exist, and for those reads the registry (RDAP), the live TLS certificate and the homepage. Each finding has a deterministic 0-100 risk score with plain reasons and an evidence record with fetch times and SHA-256 hashes. Built for crypto brands first. Watched brands return a full report from the operator's collector, refreshed twice a day; a brand not yet watched gets a quick DNS-only check, labelled unchecked, and is scanned in full on the next collector run. Use since to get only what changed since the last call. Detection and evidence only: findings are observed signals, not a finding of fraud; no takedowns.

inputSchema.description: POST /v1/brand/scan takes {official_domains, brand?, keywords?, since?, limit?}; POST /v1/brand/lookalikes takes {domain, since?, limit?}; POST /v1/brand/evidence takes {evidence_id}. GET /v1/brand/watched takes no body.

official_domains.description: scan: the brand's real domains, e.g. ["aave.com"]. An unwatched brand is added to the watch list.

keywords.description: scan: extra words to try in lookalike names.

domain.description: lookalikes: one domain, e.g. metamask.io. Not added to the watch list.

evidence_id.description: evidence: the id from a finding.

since.description: scan and lookalikes: ISO 8601 time; return only findings that changed after it.

limit.description: scan and lookalikes: how many findings to return, highest risk first.

outputSchema.description: scan and lookalikes return the report below. evidence returns {service, version, fetched_at, evidence_id, brand_id, domain, collected_at, method, sources[], dns, rdap, certificate, homepage, ct_log_entry}. watched returns {service, version, fetched_at, count, max_watched, brands[]}. Errors return {error: {code, message}} with HTTP 4xx. Published schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/organiccryptoyyc/pocket-agentic-services/main/brand-protection/openapi.json

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was collected.

next_step.description: quick only: how to get a full report.

partial.description: true when not every candidate was checked.

reasons: page asks to connect a wallet or enter a recovery phrase (+20)

responseSummary.note: Abridged; captured on Pocket MainNet 2026-11-04. Findings are observed signals, not a finding of fraud.
